title: Neverwhere
author: Neil Gaiman
summary: A young Londoner stops to help an injured girl on the street and is suddenly invisible to the people he knew. He is left to follow her into London Below, a hidden city of strange characters under and between the streets.
readIf: you want a dark, funny urban fantasy that treats the city's map and history as magic.
skipIf: you want a deep plot or emotional weight, since it is more about its odd inventions than depth.

pairings.reason: Another fast fantasy that uses different versions of London and a rogue at its centre.
Another very British, humour-laced supernatural adventure with a brisk comic style.
The older story it plays on, where a bewildered visitor falls into a world of absurd rules.
